FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

New does not mean defect-free. Most new units have dozens of defects — hollow tiles, poor alignment, leaking joints, electrical faults — that are difficult to spot without training and instruments. The developer is obliged to fix them during the DLP, but only if they are properly identified and reported.
We operate across Johor, Melaka, Negeri Sembilan and Selangor — and we are flexible for other locations. Contact us to check availability for your area.
As soon as you receive your keys, and well before the Defect Liability Period (DLP) expires. During the DLP the developer is obliged to rectify defects at no cost to you — once it lapses, every repair becomes your expense.
Usually it is the best money you will spend. Hidden defects — waterproofing failure, wiring problems, structural cracks — can cost tens of thousands after you move in. Knowing beforehand lets you negotiate, plan repairs, or walk away.
For a standard unit an inspection typically takes 2 to 4 hours; landed and commercial properties take longer. The full report follows within a few working days — we confirm the exact timeline in your quotation.
It depends on property type, size and the scope you need, so we quote per property rather than publishing a flat rate. Send us the property type, built-up area and location on WhatsApp and you will get a clear quotation — usually within one working hour.
